rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verify session boundary before deciding prompt's context-carrying.
rules_evaluated.evidence: On the parent rule's own cold-vs-warm classification test, and sub-clause 40a (concurrent-worktree corollary, no worktree content on this page): the 'Primed context list' example (L29) correctly frames itself as reading an EXISTING scrollback ("Read this scrollback: ..."), assuming a warm session rather than misclassifying a cold one - no session-boundary misclassification. But sub-clause 40b (Warm ≠ referent-present) is violated by that same example: "Read this scrollback: the plan walk-down, the push-back that changed the plan, what came back from the send-off, the critique exchange." This is explicitly claimed by the page's own top-of-file framing (L11, "italicised quote from a real Agents 101 or AE101 prompt") and maintainer block ("Examples-in-the-wild: drawn from real Agents 101 and AE101 prompts") to be a REAL prompt. Repo-wide search (grep -rn 'plan walk-down|push-back that changed the plan|came back from the send-off' across every tracked .md file including docs/archive/) finds this exact phrase NOWHERE else in the repository; the one prompt sharing its shape and one item ('the critique exchange'), `curriculum/prompts/ae101-m3-sharpen-skill.md`, actually reads 'the access-control output, the STRIDE decision and ADR, the moment the skill was invoked on the security-tested feature, the critique exchange' in its full git history back to its first commit (git log -p --follow confirms no version ever said 'plan walk-down'/'send-off'/'push-back that changed the plan'). §40b's own text names 'the send-off' by name as a risky curriculum-coined activity label that 'reaches the agent ONLY if a prior PROMPT typed those exact words' - and no prior prompt anywhere in this repo ever did. HARM: this is the page's flagship worked example for the 'Primed context list' move, presented as proof the technique works on real curriculum text; a curriculum author or student modelling their own prompt on it is modelling three fabricated/untraceable session-moment labels dressed as verified reality, which is exactly the referent-vacuum §40b exists to catch, compounded by an explicit-but-unmet sourcing claim.
